items.title: Are you safe?
lines: If you are hurt or in danger, call the emergency number first
You can call it from any phone, even without a SIM card
Somewhere else? Try 112 from a mobile phone. Most networks connect it to the local emergency number

items.title:
Keep calm
and
carry on
lines: Breathe in slowly through your nose
Breathe out slowly through your mouth
Do it 3 times
It happened to me too. We will go through it one step at a time

items.title: On a borrowed phone or computer?
lines: Open a private window
Sign out of every account when you are done

items.title: Lock your phone
lines: On any phone or computer, open the page for your phone. Sign in

lines.text: ➡️ This also suspends Apple Pay on the phone
Asked for a code you cannot get? Try android.com/lock. It needs only your phone number

lines: The same page shows where the phone is. Do not go there yourself. Give the location to the police

items.title: Block your SIM card and IMEI
items.time: About 10 minutes, plus time on hold
lines: Call your mobile operator from any phone. The number is on your bill, your contract or their website
1️⃣ Ask them to block the SIM
➡️ A blocked SIM cannot be used to receive login codes
2️⃣ Ask them to block the phone by its IMEI too. They can often see the number on your account
➡️ A blocked phone stops working on networks that check the list
⚠️ Don't forget to block secondary sims / e-sims

items.title: Block payments

alert.title: They are after your bank, not your phone
alert.text: of identity fraud victims had money taken from their bank account
lines: Your phone PIN will not stop them. Thieves watch you type it
Call your bank. The number is on the back of your card
No card with you? Type your bank's web address yourself. The number is on the site
⚠️ Do not search for the number. Scammers buy ads with fake bank numbers

lines.text: 1️⃣ Ask them to block your cards in Apple Pay and their banking app on the stolen phone
1️⃣ Ask them to block your cards in Google Wallet and their banking app on the stolen phone

lines: 2️⃣ Wallet stolen too? Ask them to block the cards as well
Ask about any payments made since the theft

items.title: Lock the account on your phone

alert.title: Thieves go for this account first
lines: If they saw your passcode, they can change its password and turn off finding your phone

lines.text: This is your Apple Account, the one your iPhone is signed in to
This is your Google account, the one your phone is signed in to

lines: 1️⃣ On another phone or a computer, sign in
2️⃣ Change the password
3️⃣ Check the recovery email and phone numbers. Remove any you do not know
Cannot sign in? Start account recovery now. Every minute counts

items.question: Lock your email
lines: Same account as the one you just locked? Choose I am in. Then skip the next step
Open your email in a new tab. Go to the security settings
Can you get in?

items.title: Lock your email

lines.text: ➡️ Forgot your password? Choose Forgot password
➡️ Asked for a code by SMS or on an authenticator? On the sign-in page, choose Try another way. A backup code or a security key works too
➡️ Still signed in on a laptop or tablet? Use that. It may not ask for a code
➡️ No other way in? Start account recovery
Once you are in, go to the security settings

lines: Remove the stolen phone from your devices and sign-in methods
1️⃣ Choose Sign out of all other devices
2️⃣ Change the password
Next, do the same for your other accounts (social media, banks, paypal ...)

items.title: Suspend your digital ID
lines: Do you sign in to your bank or the government with an app on the phone? Suspend it
For example itsme in Belgium, DigiD in the Netherlands, BankID in Sweden, Singpass in Singapore or My Number in Japan
Use its website or helpline, or ask your bank

items.title: Warn your contacts
lines: From another phone or your email, message family and close friends
Tell them your phone was stolen. A message from your number asking for money or codes is not you
⚠️ Warn them that your identity might be stolen and to be careful with messages from you

items.title: Watch for phishing
lines: ⚠️ Given recent theft, you are in a vulnerable state. Be extra careful
⚠️ Do not click on random links in your mailbox
⚠️ If the bank calls you, ask them for a name and call them back
⚠️ Companies will never ask your passwords or codes. If they do, it is a scam

items.title: Work phone? Tell your IT team
lines: Also if you read work email or chat on it
They can lock your work accounts and erase work data

items.title: Report the theft to the police
lines: Go to a station, or report online if your country allows it
⚠️ Get a copy of the report and a reference number
Your bank, insurer and operator will ask for them
Your report to the operator does not reach the police. Make both

lines.text: Bring the IMEI number if you can find it. It is on the phone box, and in your Apple account
Bring the IMEI number if you can find it. It is on the phone box, and in your Google account

items.title: Anything else?
lines: Think about what else was on the phone: other banks, shopping, crypto, health, social media
Lock or change the password of each one
⚠️ This list is not complete. Rules are different in every country
I am not a lawyer, a bank or a security company. You use this advice at your own risk. I cannot be held responsible for any loss
